source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units may re-roll a **[wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** of 1 for their attacks while in a **terrain area**.

Such a unit is **entrenched** while all of these are true:

- It is in a **terrain area**.
- It has not been set up this turn.
- None of its models moved over 3" this turn.

**DARNATH LYSANDER** and **TOR GARADON** units have **Defensive Mastery**: as each phase starts, the unit becomes **entrenched**, whatever the conditions above say.

Your army may contain **IMPERIAL FISTS** units, though no **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units of any other Chapter.
